summary: Colour maths Unity omits: hex conversion, hue rotation, and related colours for procedural palettes.
overview: Colour helpers Unity's Color API does not provide: parse and emit hex strings, and derive related colours from a base hue. The palette side is the useful half — rotate one brand colour to get a set of visually distinct team colours, or a complementary highlight, without hand-picking each one.
useCases: Generating N distinct team or player colours from one base hue.
Reading colours authored as hex in a spreadsheet, ScriptableObject or JSON.
Deriving a highlight or outline colour that stays in keeping with a base colour.

gotchas.title: A malformed hex string returns magenta, it does not throw
gotchas.body: FromHex logs a warning and hands back magenta, so a typo in authored data shows up loudly on screen instead of crashing. Do not treat a magenta result as a valid colour.

gotchas.title: ToHex drops alpha unless you ask for it
gotchas.body: The default is 6 digits. Pass includeAlpha: true for the 8-digit form, or a translucent colour round-trips as opaque.
